summary: BioMar Chile has obtained ISO 17025 accreditation for its laboratories under international quality standards. The certification demonstrates the company's commitment to testing and quality assurance in its Chilean aquaculture feed operations.
title: BioMar Chile acreditó sus laboratorios bajo norma ISO 17025
title_en: BioMar Chile acreditó sus laboratorios bajo norma ISO 17025

summary: BioMar has entered into an agreement with a Canadian firm to incorporate probiotics into its aquaculture feed products. The partnership represents a product innovation initiative by the feed producer to enhance its feed formulations.
title: BioMar incorporará probióticos a su alimento en convenio con firma canadiense
title_en: BioMar incorporará probióticos a su alimento en convenio con firma canadiense

summary: BioMar reported disappointing financial results for the first quarter of 2013. The article highlights weakness in the company's quarterly performance during this period.
title: Magert første kvartal for BioMar
